title: DID a giant magnet in the temple really pull Portuguese ships off course? #Shorts
description:
DID a giant magnet in the temple really pull Portuguese ships off course?

Legend says a 52-ton natural lodestone was embedded in the main shikhara, causing ship compasses to malfunction and shipwrecking Portuguese traders, who later removed it. Metallurgical reality: massive iron beams (some 10m long, 90 tons) were forge-welded into the stone joints, but the floating magnet remains an unverified oral tradition.

Produced by ARIA Sacred Heritage AI. Subscribe for the full 52-minute documentary.
